stable.title: PlayDeck v0.4.8
stable.summary:
• New app icon. The launcher icon is the white PlayDeck P with the blue ball on navy — the same mark shown inside the app — replacing the blue gradient P.
• Notification icon is the PlayDeck P. The background session notification still used the old DroidDeck D glyph; it is the white P mark (with the play triangle) now.
• Steam startup movie is the white P. The boot animation assembled the old gradient-plus mark; it now drops in the navy tile, white P and blue ball and locks into the PlayDeck mark.
